title: ModuleCategoryService
responsibility: Reads the project responsibility taxonomy for authoring, structural audit and revision-bound catalogs.

inputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.load.directory
inputs.description: Project or workspace directory; lookup stops at the repository boundary.

inputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.at.tree
inputs.description: Readable source tree of the selected revision, never the current checkout.

outputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.load
outputs.description: Nearest project root and validated category data, or undefined before category adoption.

outputs.name: ModuleCategoryService.at
outputs.description: Validated taxonomy stored by that revision; undefined when no category file is present.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The category file is not valid JSON or has invalid or duplicate category definitions.
